post.news: Sony Pictures TV signed creator Thea Von Engelbrechten to a multiyear deal and launched her new animated microdrama Hazelwood.
post.take: Going from playing with tiny animal toys on TikTok to pitching Sony is the ultimate glow-up.
post.insight: Traditional studios are skipping writer's rooms and partnering directly with independent creators who already built their own audiences.
